notes: C's mob prototypes set class 0, so this level-9 switched body gets the class/level refusal before any later gate or draw. The handler has no WAIT_STATE (src/new_cmds.c:1552-1739).

An immortal-level mobile passes the class/level gate, draws number(1,101), then each seal's shared dummy_mob skill determines the mastery gate and outcome. The array starts zero; restore and Lua set_skill can mutate it. C has no WAIT_STATE in this handler.

do_restore sets every skill to 100 for an immortal-level target restored by a greater god; SET_SKILL reaches the shared NPC dummy_mob record. Go's restore actor path and Lua set_skill must keep that shared state visible to this family.
After do_restore sets the shared mobile skill to 100, switched rin must consume one number(1,101) draw, apply the success affects, and route actor and room bytes through the switched body.
